name: banorte-hackmty2026
description: Hackathon Banorte x Tec 2026 - Interfaces vivas construidas por IA

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "red.bold,cyan.bold" "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix frontend && npm test --prefix backend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend
